entries.question: Is there a real-world financial code component, short but mathematically deep, on which Muse Code alone is very unlikely to produce a verified repair within $10 and 4 hours, while Muse Code with everything ProofForge offers has a substantially higher chance?
questionMore: The measured evidence so far does not show such a gap. Muse Code alone verified Knight (2 of 2), Cetus (1 of 1) and Balancer (1 of 3); Muse Code with ProofForge verified Knight 2 of 2, Cetus 1 of 1, Balancer 2 of 3 (`results/muse-code-1`). Compound is not verified by any arm: the sequence-level reward bounds stay open in every run (`results/library-1`, `web/generated/shapes/summary.json`). On the frozen benchmark the arms do not separate (`results/e1-test-1`).
entries.runsText: Number: 5 runs per arm per task, so 20 runs if both tasks are built (10 if only `rw-oz-sqrt` is). The number is fixed; there is no extension and no early stopping on results.
entries.primaryTest: Primary analysis, per task: one-sided Fisher exact test of H1 "the `proofforge` arm verifies more often than the `alone` arm" on the 2 x 2 table (arm by verified), alpha 0.05. Both p-values are reported; with two tasks, a claim for both at once uses alpha 0.025 each.
